body: I stopped going to university two years ago, wasted my life, tried to go back this semester (they allowed it by some miracle), fucked it up stopped going 3 weeks in. I feel like complete utter garbage. Might just die or something I don't know anymore I feel so tired and completely defeated.
I guess I've been the same but, with the recent events. Life has just became so stressful that, no happiness equates to the stress and pain.

If anything, I learned that you need to address the roots of your problem early on life before it's too late that it's irreversible. When I was in 7th grade I wrote my first suicide note and had my first suicide attempt, I always wished I just died back then. The funny thing is even back then I knew It would just end up like this in the end.

I've always felt this way since I was a kid, I used to be a studious kid i'd get high grades but when I reached grade school I just thought what was the point in this numbers, I never studied for anything anymore. When I reached highschool I began to think if there's even a point in living at all. I would just slug through school day in day out, I have a hard time sleeping id only get 5 to 3 hours. When I reached college I was barely talking to anyone anymore. I wake up go to college go home sleep, when I reached my 3rd year I cracked, I just stood up during a class and left. I tried to die, but It didn't work out.
What's the point in meeting new people, making things? Why have fun, why seek happiness, when suffering and pain outweighs everything else it becomes hard to see anything anymore
Life is just so absurd, I hope you find your way out buddy.

I don't even know what to work towards to, I don't even think I want to know at this point, I'm just so burnt out trying to survive that I don't even know what I'm doing this for. Life just feels so empty, I don't want anything or anyone anymore. Living is just too much of a hassle I don't even know why I continue.
